paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s basketball teams came out of Saturday’s preseason jamboree with a boys win and tie and two girls wins, according to Hardwired 662 interview captions shared by Pontotoc Athletics. The jamboree was held Oct. 31.
The boys beat West Union 41–21 and tied Tupelo 45–45, the boys interview caption reports. Both outcomes came in preseason play.
The girls interview caption reports wins against Starkville and Choctaw Central but does not give scores. Our earlier weekly schedule, linked below, previewed the jamboree.
